answer: Take away the harbor and the name falls away; take away the jade and the stake falls away; take away the haven and the whole past falls away. Checking is dull by design: the paint stays fresh, the mark gets checked, the date stays fixed. Some checks are for sale; Dollmaker spinning top proof counted beside the doll loft is not, because each spinning top is a count of whittled joints checked beside the paint mark comes from hands the applicant has never met. Forge once and the fine is 2 times the stake, so a 100 POA proof becomes a 2x wound.
